chunks: And in the narration of al-Sakūnī:

That ʿAlī عليه السلام used to give inheritance to the Magian, if he married his mother, his sister, or his daughter, from two aspects: from the aspect that she was his mother, and from the aspect that she was his wife.

key_terms.مِنْ وَجْهَيْنِ: from two legal aspects or considerations
key_terms.يُوَرِّثُ: to assign or grant inheritance shares

ai.seo_question: How did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام rule on inheritance for a Magian who married a close blood relative?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling attributed to Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام regarding the inheritance of a Magian involved in a marriage considered invalid in Islam. It indicates that inheritance shares were calculated according to the multiple relational statuses recognized in that case, such as motherhood and wifehood.
